facts.fact: Rosie 在头天晚上十点后（sometime after ten the night before）把周末的最终数字发给 Carson；Carson 盯着电子表格直到数字发花，两天营收多到她觉得不真实。
facts.anchor: Rosie had sent me the final numbers sometime after ten the night before

facts.fact: Carson 对 Blueberry 说这个周末有 approximately four hundred people 夸它漂亮，但 Blueberry 连头都没抬、只甩了下尾巴。
facts.anchor: you had approximately four hundred people telling you how beautiful you were this weekend

facts.fact: Carson 承认谷仓展示的旧照片里是她自己（I couldn’t have been more than seventeen）和 Blueberry，照片里 Blueberry 正绕过第三个桶 third barrel。
facts.anchor: me and Blueberry—I couldn’t have been more than seventeen

facts.fact: Beau 在傍晚 shortly before six that night 开车来接 Carson 去他家吃晚饭；此前 Carson 为挑衣服在衣柜前站了 nearly fifteen minutes，最后抓起黑短裤。
facts.anchor: Beau picked me up shortly before six that night

facts.fact: 在 Jones 家晚饭上，Margaret 做了足够 twelve people 吃的食物，尽管只有 seven of us；Walter 嘴上抱怨做多了，却吃了 two helpings。
facts.anchor: Margaret had cooked enough food for twelve people, despite there being only seven of us

facts.fact: Jax 晚饭迟到，因为 apparently spent forty minutes 帮 Rosie 搬某样东西，而那东西她本可以让 six festival volunteers 来搬。
facts.anchor: Jax arrived late because he had apparently spent forty minutes helping Rosie move something she could’ve asked six festival volunteers to move

facts.fact: 事故后数月，Pops 曾花 months 用 Blueberry 配合治疗，Carson 第一次重新上马后 approximately thirty seconds 觉得自己又变回了原来的自己。
facts.anchor: for approximately thirty seconds, I had felt like myself again

facts.fact: 周四傍晚 Carson 在马场再次上马，Blueberry 载着她大概走了 maybe twenty steps 横穿场地（没有桶也没有速度），Carson 泪流满面地下来并抱住它的脖子。
facts.anchor: Blueberry had taken maybe twenty steps
